title: The Ghost of Geneva
author: C. M. Nakamura
blurb: Paloma Hartwell, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
